_about: Yugi's notes on each set. intro: said when you open a set's card list before you own any of it. cards: lines per card (names joined by ' | ' share lines), said when you look at the card or pull it. Only cards that mattered in real decks of the era, or that Yugi remembers from his, Kaiba's or Joey's duels. A card's worth depends on where the series is: a note with 'until' (a set code) is only said up to that set, since Fissure is great at the start and not twenty sets later. Memories never expire. _multiples: cards a deck wants more than one of, with why (and 'until'); Yugi speaks up on a 2nd or later copy, up to want. Every name is checked by scripts/guide/build.mjs. Keep lines under 140 characters, in Yugi's voice.

Pot of Greed.why: Tournaments only allowed one, but here every copy is two free cards!

Raigeki.why: Tournaments only allowed one. Here, every copy can wipe their whole field!

Monster Reborn.why: Tournaments only allowed one. Here you can bring back their best monster again and again!

Change of Heart.why: Tournaments only allowed one, but nothing stops us running more here!

Dark Hole.why: It hits your monsters too, but a second one gives you another way out when they're ahead.

Snatch Steal.why: Stealing their best monster for good never gets old. Every copy counts!

Mirror Force.why: Each one can wipe out their whole attack. They'll be scared to swing at all!

Heavy Storm.why: Clearing their back row twice can win a duel all by itself.

Tribute to the Doomed.why: Monster removal is never wasted. A second answer is always welcome!

Mystical Space Typhoon.why: Real decks ran two or three of these, so their traps never feel safe.

Sangan.why: It replaces itself every time. Almost every deck ran these searchers.

Witch of the Black Forest.why: She replaces herself and finds your best monster. Almost every deck ran her!

Delinquent Duo.why: Two cards from their hand for one of yours. That trade adds up fast!

The Forceful Sentry.why: Seeing their hand and taking their best card is worth doing twice.

Nobleman of Crossout.why: Face-down monsters are everywhere. A second Nobleman always finds a target.

Mystic Tomato.why: It floats into a new monster when it's destroyed. Three keeps your field full!

Nimble Momonga.why: It calls its own copies from your deck, so it really wants all three!

Magician of Faith.why: Getting your best spell back again is pure card advantage.

Drop Off.why: Top decks ran more than one. Throwing away their fresh draw never stops hurting!

Don Zaloog.why: Every hit costs them a card. Two Don Zaloogs keep the pressure on!

Spirit Reaper.why: It can't be destroyed in battle, so a second one is twice the wall.

Exiled Force.why: A monster that trades itself for anything is worth a second slot.

Torrential Tribute.why: One trap that clears the whole field. Two makes them scared to summon!

Book of Moon.why: It stops an attack, saves your monster, or resets a flip. Always useful!

Summoned Skull.why: 2500 ATK for one tribute. A second Skull means you draw into one sooner.

Gemini Elf.why: The best monster you can summon for free. Decks ran all three!

Blue-Eyes White Dragon.why: Kaiba ran three of these. Now you know how it feels!

Axe of Despair.why: It comes back every time, so a second Axe makes even small monsters scary.

Cyber Dragon.why: Every deck wanted three. A free 2100 ATK monster whenever they summon first!

intro: This is where it all began! Grandpa's Blue-Eyes is in here somewhere... but Pot of Greed and Fissure will win you more duels.
Our very first set! Don't chase the dragons. Every pack has a Rare, and the good ones are what you really need.

Blue-Eyes White Dragon: Blue-Eyes White Dragon! 3000 ATK, the strongest monster in the whole set. Kaiba would be so jealous!
Dark Magician: My Dark Magician! If he's in your deck, I'll be cheering extra loud.
Red-Eyes Black Dragon: Red-Eyes Black Dragon! Joey's favorite. It's got potential, just like him.
Monster Reborn: Monster Reborn! Bring back the best monster in either Graveyard. Hardly anyone will have one of these.
Raigeki: Raigeki wipes out every monster they control. Wow, the heart of the cards is really with you!
Dark Hole: Dark Hole clears the whole field, yours too. Save it for when they're ahead.

lines: Man-Eater Bug looks goofy, but when it flips, any monster on the field is gone. Set it and wait!
Trap Hole! When they summon something with 1000 ATK or more, it's gone before it can swing.

Pot of Greed: Pot of Greed! Two free cards, no catch. Every deck wants this one.

lines: Fissure takes out their weakest face-up monster. Simple, but it clears the way to attack!
Hane-Hane flips and bounces any monster back to the hand. Great against their tribute monsters!

Exodia the Forbidden One | Left Arm of t: A piece of Exodia! I beat Kaiba with all five the very first time we dueled. Get them all and you win!
Gaia The Fierce Knight: Gaia the Fierce Knight! He rode with me against Kaiba. Fuse him with Curse of Dragon for the Dragon Champion!
Curse of Dragon: Curse of Dragon! I fused it with Gaia to make Gaia the Dragon Champion. A great team!
Celtic Guardian: Celtic Guardian! He fought for me in Duelist Kingdom. 1400 ATK and no tribute, a loyal swordsman.
Swords of Revealing Light: Swords of Revealing Light! It bought me time in so many duels. Three turns with no attacks from them!
Polymerization: Polymerization! Kaiba used one to fuse three Blue-Eyes into the Ultimate Dragon. I'll never forget that.
Hitotsu-Me Giant: Hitotsu-Me Giant! Kaiba played this one in our very first duel. Feels like a long time ago.
Flame Swordsman: Flame Swordsman! Joey's ace in Duelist Kingdom. He won so many duels with that sword.

intro: Metal Raiders brings the first great traps, like Mirror Force and Solemn Judgment. They're Ultras, so treasure any you find!
Summoned Skull and Kuriboh are both in here! And 7 Colored Fish is a common now... 1800 ATK with no tribute.

Mirror Force: Mirror Force! When they attack, all their Attack Position monsters are destroyed. Let them come!
Change of Heart: Change of Heart! Borrow their best monster for a turn. This one's always been special to me.
Solemn Judgment: Solemn Judgment stops anything, at the cost of half your Life Points. Use it when it really counts.

lines: Magic Jammer! Toss a card and their spell is gone. Save it for their Raigeki or Dark Hole.
Horn of Heaven stops a summon cold. Tribute a weak monster and their big play is wasted!

Heavy Storm: Heavy Storm clears every spell and trap on the field. Perfect before you attack into their back row.

lines: Tribute to the Doomed! Discard a card and destroy any monster. That's an answer to almost everything.

Kuriboh: Kuriboh! Discard him and you take no damage from that attack. He's saved me more times than I can count.
Barrel Dragon: Barrel Dragon shoots down a monster with a few lucky coin flips. Bandit Keith's favorite, though...
Catapult Turtle: Catapult Turtle launches your monsters for damage. Fun, but it costs you cards. Think before you fire!
Gate Guardian: Gate Guardian! The Paradox Brothers threw it at Joey and me in the labyrinth. What a duel that was!
Sanga of the Thunder | Kazejin | Suijin: One of the three guardians! When it's attacked, it can drop the attacker's ATK to 0.

lines: 7 Colored Fish! 1800 ATK, no tribute, and it's a common. Expect to see a few across the table too.
Summoned Skull! One of my favorites. 2500 ATK for a single tribute, and they'll have to answer it fast.

Time Wizard | Baby Dragon | Thousand Dra: Time Wizard and Baby Dragon fuse into Thousand Dragon! Joey and I loved that combo.
Sangan: Sangan! When it leaves the field, you search a monster with 1500 or less ATK. It replaces itself, so it's never a wasted card.
Witch of the Black Forest: Witch of the Black Forest! When she leaves the field, grab a monster with 1500 or less DEF. Even Summoned Skull!
Magician of Faith: Magician of Faith flips and gets a spell back from your Graveyard. Imagine getting Pot of Greed twice!
Saggi the Dark Clown: Saggi the Dark Clown! Kaiba opened with it in our first duel. He's come a long way since then.
Harpie Lady | Harpie Lady Sisters: Mai's Harpie Ladies! Joey had a tough time with them in Duelist Kingdom.
Elegant Egotist: With a Harpie Lady out, Elegant Egotist calls the Harpie Lady Sisters. Mai's favorite trick!

intro: Spell Ruler is all about spells! Snatch Steal and Mystical Space Typhoon are the ones to dream about.
Pegasus's Toons and Relinquished are in here! They're tricky to play, but they can surprise anyone.

Snatch Steal: Snatch Steal! Take their best monster and keep it. They gain some Life Points, but who cares?
Mystical Space Typhoon: Mystical Space Typhoon! Destroy any spell or trap, even on their turn. Their Mirror Force won't save them!
Toon World: Toon World! Pegasus's favorite. The Toons can't be played without it, so build around it carefully.
Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon | Toon Summoned Sk: A Toon! It needs Toon World on the field first. Pegasus made it look easy... it isn't.
Another of Pegasus's Toons! Without Toon World it can't even come out, so don't play it alone.
Relinquished: Relinquished absorbs one of their monsters and takes its strength. Pegasus used it on me... scary!
Black Illusion Ritual: Black Illusion Ritual summons Relinquished. Without it, he can't come out to play.

lines: Confiscation lets you peek at their hand and throw away their best card. Knowing their plan is half the duel!

Delinquent Duo: Delinquent Duo! Pay 1000 and they lose two cards from their hand. That's a huge swing.
The Forceful Sentry: The Forceful Sentry! See their hand and send their best card back to the deck.

lines: Painful Choice digs through your deck for the card you need. Whatever they pick, you win something.
Axe of Despair gives 1000 ATK, and it keeps coming back. Your monsters will hit like dragons!

Giant Trunade: Giant Trunade sends every spell and trap back to the hand. Clear their traps, then attack!

lines: Banisher of the Light banishes anything that would go to the Graveyard. No Monster Reborn for anyone!

Spellbinding Circle: Spellbinding Circle! I used it to hold back some huge monsters. They can't attack or change position!

lines: Mystic Tomato! When it's destroyed in battle, a DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK comes out from your deck to replace it.
Nimble Momonga! Destroyed in battle, it gives you 1000 Life Points and calls more Momongas from your deck.

intro: Pharaoh's Servant! Call of the Haunted and Premature Burial finally give Monster Reborn some company.
Jinzo and Imperial Order are both in here. One stops every trap, the other every spell. They're Secret Rares, though!

Jinzo: Jinzo! While he's face-up, nobody can activate traps. Espa Roba used him against Joey... it was scary!
Imperial Order: Imperial Order shuts down every spell on the field. Just remember the 700 Life Points each Standby Phase!
Call of the Haunted: Call of the Haunted brings one of your monsters back from the Graveyard. A trap they won't see coming!
Premature Burial: Premature Burial! Pay 800 Life Points and your fallen monster is back in the fight.
Buster Blader: Buster Blader! He was in my deck too. He gains 500 ATK for every dragon they have, so Kaiba hated him!
Thousand-Eyes Restrict: Thousand-Eyes Restrict! Pegasus fused it from Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Idol. No other monster can attack!
Magical Hats: Magical Hats! I hid my monsters under these against Kaiba. Let them guess which one is real!

lines: Nobleman of Crossout destroys a face-down monster and banishes it. Perfect against flip effects!

Dust Tornado: Dust Tornado destroys one of their spells or traps, then you get to set a card. A clean trade!
Gearfried the Iron Knight: Gearfried the Iron Knight! Joey's knight. 1800 ATK with no tribute, just no equip cards.
The Legendary Fisherman: The Legendary Fisherman! Mako's ace. While Umi is on the field, it can't be attacked.
Parasite Paracide: Parasite Paracide! Weevil snuck it into Joey's deck in Battle City. So sneaky!

lines: Goblin Attack Force! 2300 ATK with no tribute. It rests after attacking, but beatdown decks loved it.

intro: Labyrinth of Nightmare has Torrential Tribute and Magic Cylinder! Two traps that can turn a whole duel around.
Gemini Elf is in here! 1900 ATK, no tribute and no catch. Nothing else like it yet, but it's a Secret Rare.

lines: Gemini Elf! 1900 ATK for no tribute at all. The twins can stand up to almost anything right now.

Magic Cylinder: Magic Cylinder stops an attack and hits them with the attacker's own ATK. They'll be sorry!
Torrential Tribute: Torrential Tribute! When a monster is summoned, every monster on the field is destroyed. Time it right!
Destiny Board: Destiny Board! Spell out F-I-N-A-L over their turns and you win. Stop it before the last letter!
Dark Necrofear: Dark Necrofear! Bakura's favorite. Banish three Fiends from your Graveyard to call her.

lines: United We Stand gives 800 ATK and DEF for every face-up monster you control. Even a small monster wins fights!
Mage Power adds 500 ATK and DEF for every spell and trap you control. Set a few first!
Kycoo! 1800 ATK with no tribute, and it banishes their Graveyard monsters. No Monster Reborn for them!
Bazoo the Soul-Eater! Banish monsters from your Graveyard and he gets 300 ATK for each. A real threat!

intro: Legacy of Darkness is great for Warriors! Reinforcement of the Army, Exiled Force and Marauding Captain are all in here.
Watch out for Yata-Garasu in here. Empty their hand first, and it can stop them drawing at all!

Yata-Garasu: Yata-Garasu! When it hits them, they skip their next draw. If their hand is empty, they're stuck!

lines: Airknight Parshath hits through defense, and draws you a card whenever it deals damage!

Fiber Jar: Fiber Jar shuffles everything back and both players draw five. A whole new duel!

lines: Freed the Matchless General! He fetches a Warrior from your deck instead of drawing.

Marauding Captain: Marauding Captain brings a friend from your hand when he's summoned, and protects your Warriors!
Exiled Force: Exiled Force! Tribute it to destroy any monster. One small card for their biggest one!
Reinforcement of the Army: Reinforcement of the Army fetches a Level 4 or lower Warrior from your deck. Like a friend coming to help!
Bottomless Trap Hole: Bottomless Trap Hole banishes a monster with 1500 or more ATK the moment it's summoned!

lines: Drop Off! Whatever they just drew goes straight to the Graveyard. That's one card they never get to use.
Injection Fairy Lily gains 3000 ATK in battle for 2000 Life Points. Powerful, but count your Life Points!

intro: Pharaonic Guardian brings Ring of Destruction and Book of Moon. And the Gravekeepers, who guard the Graveyard!
Don Zaloog and Spirit Reaper are in here. They tear apart the other duelist's hand!

Ring of Destruction: Ring of Destruction blows up their monster, and you both take its ATK as damage. Watch your Life Points!
Book of Moon: Book of Moon flips a monster face-down. It can stop an attack or save your own monster!
Lava Golem: Lava Golem! You take two of their monsters to give it to them, and it burns them every turn.
Spirit Reaper: Spirit Reaper can't be destroyed in battle, and a direct hit makes them discard at random!

lines: Don Zaloog! When he hits them, they lose a random card from their hand, or the top two of their deck.

Necrovalley: Necrovalley! Gravekeepers get stronger, and nobody can take cards out of the Graveyard.

lines: Mirage of Nightmare draws until you hold four on their turn. You discard them later, so use them fast!

intro: Magician's Force! Dark Magician Girl is in here. She was my partner in so many duels!
Breaker the Magical Warrior and Tribe-Infecting Virus are in this set, and Kaiba's X, Y and Z machines too!

Dark Magician Girl: Dark Magician Girl! My Dark Magician's apprentice. She gains 300 ATK for every Dark Magician in the Graveyards!
Breaker the Magical Warrior: Breaker the Magical Warrior! Summon him, then use his spell counter to destroy a spell or trap.
Dark Paladin: Dark Paladin! I fused Dark Magician with Buster Blader to beat Kaiba's dragons. He can stop a spell too!
XYZ-Dragon Cannon: XYZ-Dragon Cannon! Kaiba's three-part machine. Discard a card to destroy anything they control.
Tribe-Infecting Virus: Tribe-Infecting Virus! Discard a card, name a Type, and every face-up monster of that Type is destroyed.
Skilled Dark Magician: Skilled Dark Magician collects spell counters. At three, tribute it for my Dark Magician!

intro: Dark Crisis is full of Archfiends and Guardians. And Skill Drain, which shuts down every effect monster!
Vampire Lord, Kaiser Glider and Exodia Necross are in here. This set has a lot of dark power!

Vampire Lord: Vampire Lord! Every hit sends a card from their deck to the Graveyard. And when an effect destroys him, he comes back!
Exodia Necross: Exodia Necross! It can't be destroyed while the five Exodia pieces are in your Graveyard. Exodia, back again!
Skill Drain: Skill Drain! Pay 1000 Life Points and every face-up monster loses its effect. Normal monsters love this!
D.D. Warrior Lady: D.D. Warrior Lady can banish a monster she battles, along with herself. A brave one-for-one!

intro: Invasion of Chaos! Chaos Emperor Dragon and the new Black Luster Soldier both need a LIGHT and a DARK to come out.
Lots of cards in this set banish instead of destroying, like Dark Mirror Force and Dark Magician of Chaos!

Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End: Chaos Emperor Dragon! Pay 1000 Life Points and every card in both hands and on the field goes to the Graveyard!
Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Begi: Black Luster Soldier, Envoy of the Beginning! Banish a monster, or attack twice. Either way, they're in trouble!
Dark Magician of Chaos: Dark Magician of Chaos! He brings a spell back from your Graveyard, and banishes what he destroys.
Dark Mirror Force: Dark Mirror Force! When they attack, every monster they have in Defense Position is banished.
Compulsory Evacuation Device: Compulsory Evacuation Device sends a monster back to the hand. Perfect against a big fusion!

intro: Ancient Sanctuary! Fairies gather at The Sanctuary in the Sky, and Zaborg is the first of the Monarchs.
Enemy Controller is in here. Kaiba loved that card, and it does two different jobs!

Enemy Controller: Enemy Controller! Switch a monster's battle position, or Tribute one of yours to take theirs for the turn.
Zaborg the Thunder Monarch: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch! Tribute Summon him and he destroys a monster. A summon and an answer in one!
Night Assailant: Night Assailant destroys a monster when it's flipped. Discard it, and a Flip monster comes back to your hand!
Level Limit - Area B: Level Limit - Area B turns every Level 4 or higher monster to Defense Position. Almost nothing can attack!
King of the Swamp: King of the Swamp stands in for a Fusion Material. Or discard it to fetch Polymerization from your deck!
Burst Stream of Destruction: Burst Stream of Destruction! With Blue-Eyes out, it destroys all their monsters. Kaiba's favorite attack!
Draining Shield: Draining Shield stops an attack, and you gain Life Points equal to that monster's ATK!

intro: Soul of the Duelist brings LV monsters! Do what they ask and they grow into something much stronger.
Mobius the Frost Monarch is in here too. Tribute Summon him and up to two Spells or Traps are destroyed!

Mobius the Frost Monarch: Mobius the Frost Monarch! Tribute Summon him and destroy up to two Spell or Trap cards. Their back row is gone!
Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8: Horus LV8! While he's out, you can negate any Spell they activate. They'll have to fight without magic!
Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6: Horus LV6 isn't touched by Spells. Destroy a monster in battle and he becomes LV8 at the End Phase!
Armed Dragon LV5: Armed Dragon LV5! Send a monster from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy one of theirs with no more ATK than it.
Mystic Swordsman LV2: Mystic Swordsman LV2 destroys any face-down monster he attacks, before it can even flip!
Hammer Shot: Hammer Shot destroys the Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. Careful, that could be yours!
Mind Crush: Mind Crush! Name a card. If it's in their hand, they discard every copy. If not, you discard one at random!
Inferno Fire Blast: Inferno Fire Blast! Red-Eyes deals its ATK straight to their Life Points. Joey would love this one!
Masked Dragon: Masked Dragon! Destroyed in battle, it brings a Dragon with 1500 or less ATK from your deck. Even another one!
Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke destroys any face-up Defense Position monster he attacks. No wall stops him!

intro: Rise of Destiny! Thestalos joins the Monarchs, and the Harpie Ladies get their own hunting ground.
Mai would love this set: three new Harpie Ladies, and Triangle Ecstasy Spark to power up the Sisters!

Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch! Tribute Summon him and they discard a random card. A monster? They take damage too!
Mirage Dragon: Mirage Dragon! While it's face-up, they can't activate Traps in the Battle Phase. Attack without fear!
Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive: Dekoichi draws you a card when it's flipped. A free card, and 1400 ATK left on the field!
Harpies' Hunting Ground: Harpies' Hunting Ground! Every Harpie Lady summoned destroys a Spell or Trap. Mai's birds rule this sky!
Divine Wrath: Divine Wrath! Discard a card to negate a monster's effect and destroy it. Even the Monarchs fear it.
The Creator: The Creator! Once a turn, send a card from your hand to the Graveyard to bring a monster back from it.
Machine Duplication: Machine Duplication! Pick a Machine of yours with 500 or less ATK, and two more copies come from your deck.
Monster Reincarnation: Monster Reincarnation: discard a card to take a monster from your Graveyard back to your hand.
Silent Swordsman LV3: Silent Swordsman LV3! Spells that target him do nothing, and he grows on your next Standby Phase. One of mine!

intro: Flaming Eternity! Lightning Vortex clears their face-up monsters, and the Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys keeps coming back.
Granmarg the Rock Monarch is here too. Tribute Summon him and a Set card is destroyed!

Lightning Vortex: Lightning Vortex! Discard a card and every face-up monster they have is destroyed. Raigeki's little brother!
Granmarg the Rock Monarch: Granmarg the Rock Monarch! Tribute Summon him to destroy a Set card. Face-down monsters and traps beware!
Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys! Destroyed by an effect, it returns next Standby Phase and wipes every Spell and Trap.
Hand of Nephthys: Hand of Nephthys! Tribute her and another monster to bring the Sacred Phoenix out from your hand or deck.
Rescue Cat: Rescue Cat! Send it to the Graveyard for two Level 3 or lower Beasts from your deck. They're destroyed at the End Phase.
Deck Devastation Virus: Deck Devastation Virus! Tribute a DARK with 2000 or more ATK, and their small monsters are destroyed for 3 turns.
Threatening Roar: Threatening Roar: they can't declare an attack this turn. A whole turn of safety from one trap!
Phoenix Wing Wind Blast: Phoenix Wing Wind Blast! Discard a card to put one of their cards back on top of their deck. They draw it again!
Chiron the Mage: Chiron the Mage! Discard a Spell to destroy one of their Spells or Traps. Once every turn!
Gearfried the Swordmaster: Gearfried the Swordmaster! Every Equip Spell you give him destroys one of their monsters.
Silent Swordsman LV5: Silent Swordsman LV5! Their Spells don't affect him at all. Hit them directly and he becomes LV7!
King Dragun: King Dragun! Your Dragons can't be targeted by effects, and he Special Summons one from your hand each turn.

intro: The Lost Millennium! The first Elemental HEROes are here: fuse them into Flame Wingman and Thunder Giant.
Brain Control and Card of Sanctity are in this set, and the huge Ancient Gear Golem!

Brain Control: Brain Control! Pay 800 Life Points and one of their face-up monsters is yours until the End Phase.
Card of Sanctity: Card of Sanctity! Banish everything in your hand and on your field, then draw until you hold two. Risky!
Ancient Gear Golem: Ancient Gear Golem! 3000 ATK, it pierces defense, and they can't use Spells or Traps when it attacks.
Elemental HERO Flame Wingman: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman! When he destroys a monster in battle, they take damage equal to its ATK!
Elemental HERO Thunder Giant: Elemental HERO Thunder Giant! Discard a card to destroy a monster with less original ATK than his.
Winged Kuriboh: Winged Kuriboh! When it's destroyed, you take no battle damage for the rest of the turn. A Kuriboh with wings!
Megarock Dragon: Megarock Dragon! Banish Rocks from your Graveyard to summon it. It gets 700 ATK and DEF for each one!
D.D. Survivor: D.D. Survivor comes back at the End Phase whenever it's banished while face-up. Hard to get rid of!

intro: Cybernetic Revolution! Cyber Dragon summons itself when only they have a monster. Every deck wanted three.
Power Bond doubles a Machine Fusion's ATK. Cyber End Dragon at 8000? One hit ends it!

Cyber Dragon: Cyber Dragon! If they have a monster and you don't, Special Summon it from your hand. 2100 ATK for free!
Cyber Twin Dragon: Cyber Twin Dragon! 2800 ATK, and it attacks twice in the same Battle Phase.
Cyber End Dragon: Cyber End Dragon! Three Cyber Dragons become 4000 ATK that pierces straight through defense.
Power Bond: Power Bond! Fuse Machines and double the Fusion's ATK. But you take its original ATK as damage at the End Phase!
Miracle Fusion: Miracle Fusion! Banish Fusion Materials from your field or Graveyard to summon an Elemental HERO Fusion.
Elemental HERO Bubbleman: Elemental HERO Bubbleman! If he's your only card, in hand and on the field, summoning him draws you two.
Dragon's Mirror: Dragon's Mirror! Banish Fusion Materials from your field or Graveyard to Fusion Summon a Dragon.
System Down: System Down! Pay 1000 Life Points and every Machine they have, on the field and in the Graveyard, is banished.
Skyscraper: Skyscraper! An Elemental HERO attacking a stronger monster gains 1000 ATK. The HEROes' home field!

intro: Elemental Energy! The Dark World monsters want to be discarded: that's when their effects go off!
Pot of Avarice is in here: shuffle five monsters from your Graveyard back and draw two cards.

Pot of Avarice: Pot of Avarice! Shuffle five monsters from your Graveyard into your deck, then draw two. Greed's cousin!
Sillva, Warlord of Dark World: Sillva, Warlord of Dark World! Discarded by an effect, he Special Summons himself with 2300 ATK.
Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World! Discard him with an effect and he hits the field with 2300 ATK.
Broww, Huntsman of Dark World: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World draws you a card when an effect discards him.
Dark World Lightning: Dark World Lightning destroys a Set card, then you discard a card. Make it a Dark World monster!
Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman: Shining Flare Wingman! 300 ATK for every Elemental HERO in your Graveyard, and he burns like Flame Wingman.
Elemental HERO Wildheart: Elemental HERO Wildheart! Traps don't affect him at all. Mirror Force? He walks right through.
Hydrogeddon: Hydrogeddon! When it destroys a monster in battle, another Hydrogeddon comes straight from your deck.
VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon! Kaiba's XYZ, even bigger: once a turn it banishes one of their cards.
King's Knight | Jack's Knight: Summon King's Knight next to Queen's Knight, and Jack's Knight joins them from your deck. My three knights!

intro: Shadow of Infinity! The three Sacred Beasts are here: Uria, Hamon and Raviel. Each asks you to give up three cards.
Treeborn Frog hops back from the Graveyard every turn. A free Tribute for your Monarchs!

Treeborn Frog: Treeborn Frog! With no Spells or Traps on your field, it returns from the Graveyard in your Standby Phase.
Uria, Lord of Searing Flames: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames! Send three face-up Traps to summon him. 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your Graveyard.
Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder! Send three face-up Continuous Spells to summon 4000 ATK.
Raviel, Lord of Phantasms: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms! Tribute three Fiends to summon him. 4000 ATK, and a token whenever they Normal Summon.
Demise, King of Armageddon: Demise, King of Armageddon! Pay 2000 Life Points and every other card on the field is destroyed.
Karma Cut: Karma Cut! Discard a card to banish a face-up monster, and every copy of it in their Graveyard.

intro: Enemy of Justice! The Destiny HEROes arrive, and Macro Cosmos banishes everything that would go to the Graveyard.
Cyber Phoenix protects your Machines, and Dimensional Fissure sends every fallen monster out of the game!

Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude: Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude! Turn over your top card. A Normal Spell? You get its effect next turn, for free!
Macro Cosmos: Macro Cosmos! While it's up, every card that would go to a Graveyard is banished instead.
Dimensional Fissure: Dimensional Fissure! Every monster that would go to a Graveyard is banished instead. Bye-bye, Treeborn Frog!
Cyber Phoenix: Cyber Phoenix! In Attack Position it stops Spells and Traps that target one of your Machines. Destroyed in battle, you draw.
Banisher of the Radiance: Banisher of the Radiance banishes every card that would go to the Graveyard. 1600 ATK of trouble!
Elemental HERO Shining Phoenix Enforcer: Shining Phoenix Enforcer! Battle can't destroy him, and he gains 300 ATK per Elemental HERO in your Graveyard.
E - Emergency Call: E - Emergency Call fetches any Elemental HERO from your deck. The right hero at the right time!
Forced Back: Forced Back! Negate a Normal or Flip Summon and send that monster back to their hand.

intro: Power of the Duelist! Elemental HERO Neos and his Neo-Spacian friends fuse without Polymerization!
Future Fusion and Overload Fusion made Chimeratech Overdragon famous: 800 ATK for every Machine you give it!

Elemental HERO Neos: Elemental HERO Neos! A hero from space with 2500 ATK. Return him and a Neo-Spacian to the deck to fuse!
Future Fusion: Future Fusion! Send the materials from your deck to the Graveyard now, and the Fusion arrives in two turns.
Overload Fusion: Overload Fusion! Banish Machines from your field or Graveyard to summon a DARK Machine Fusion.
Chimeratech Overdragon: Chimeratech Overdragon! 800 ATK for each material, and it can attack that many of their monsters in one turn!
Destiny HERO - Dogma: Destiny HERO - Dogma! Tribute three monsters, a Destiny HERO among them. In their Standby Phase, their Life Points are halved!
Sabersaurus: Sabersaurus! 1900 ATK with no Tribute. A Dinosaur that hits as hard as anything its size.
Mausoleum of the Emperor: Mausoleum of the Emperor! Pay 1000 Life Points for each Tribute you don't have, and Normal Summon anyway.
